India's textile sector sees export growth and sustainability focus

India's textile industry, which supports over 49 million livelihoods, is experiencing a period of growth and a push towards sustainability. In August, textile exports rose by 16.1 percent, reaching Rs 29,776 crore, with cotton and handicrafts leading this broad-based increase. The sector is undergoing a transformative shift, aiming to weave sustainability into its future growth.
